children.name: This UI Kit was built to capture the quality and design principles of Fey interface, transforming them into adaptable, reusable components. After an in-depth analysis and over 100 hours of detailed work, this kit includes 20+ graph and chart styles, well-structured components with Auto Layout, 10+ UI screens, and more than 150 elements. This journey taught me so much about design craftsmanship, and I'm sharing it here to inspire others in creating premium interfaces.
